verdict.rationale: Poly's docs describe one-off agent requests ("Automate tasks like organizing a folder"), multi-step tasks, a scriptable CLI, and built-in background indexing. None of these is a user-definable rule that fires actions automatically on file or other events. The scriptable CLI is a developer building block, and on-request agent tasks are one-off actions rather than event-triggered rules, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
